composer.attachFailed: I couldn't attach this file. Try a smaller file or a different type.

stream.emptyBody: Ask the team for something — coordination routes the work.
dm.threadEmpty: No messages in this conversation yet.
dm.emptyBody: Message a teammate privately — each persona answers with its own context.
dm.pickBody: Conversations are on the left; unread ones show in amber.
dm.subtitle: Private conversations with each persona
context.compactMark: Before this point the AI kept only a summary, so the conversation fits in its memory.
dm.suggest.coordination.1: Organize this week’s priorities for the team.
dm.suggest.coordination.2: Who is free to pick up a new task?
dm.suggest.coordination.3: Give me a summary of what is stuck.
dm.suggest.engineering.1: Review the latest code and point out risks.
dm.suggest.engineering.3: What can we automate in our workflow?
dm.suggest.research.2: Summarize this topic in 5 points for me.
dm.suggest.research.3: What data do we need to decide this?
dm.suggest.support.2: Draft template replies for the most common questions.
dm.suggest.support.3: Which customers have been waiting the longest?
dm.suggest.content.1: Suggest 5 post ideas for this week.
dm.suggest.content.2: Review this text’s tone against our brand voice.
dm.suggest.default.1: What can you do for me today?
dm.suggest.default.2: Read the Vault and tell me what you understood about the company.
dm.suggest.default.3: Suggest a first task for yourself.
subjects.loadError: Could not load topics right now.
subjects.emptyBody: Switch topic or send the first message here.
subjects.addFull: Up to 7 topics. Archive one to open another.
gestorPlan.title: {name} plan
gestorPlan.adjustModalLead: Say what to change. Your note goes to the chat so the persona can revise the plan.
gestorPlan.adjustModalPlaceholder: E.g. hire only 2 personas and skip design for now.
composer.limitsDismissHint: Closes when you send the next message.
engineBanner.title: The team needs an AI to work.
engineBanner.body.noneConnected: I couldn’t find an AI tool on this computer. Connect one and the team will reply again.
engineBanner.body.loginRequired: The AI is installed, but you still need to sign in. Log in once in the terminal.
engineBanner.body.quotaExhausted: The AI quota ran out for now. Your messages are kept and the team resumes when it comes back.
engineBanner.retained: Messages kept: {count}. The team replies as soon as an AI connects.
engineBanner.resumed: AI connected. Resuming the kept messages: {count}.
runError.notLoggedIn.title: {provider} isn’t connected on this computer.
runError.notLoggedIn.body: Sign in once in the terminal and try again. Persona never asks for your password.
runError.notInstalled.title: {provider} isn’t installed on this computer.
runError.notInstalled.body: Install {provider} or pick another engine for this persona.
runError.model.title: The {model} model isn’t available on {provider}.
runError.model.body: Pick another model. Everything else about the persona stays the same.
runError.quota.title: {provider} quota is used up for now.
runError.quota.bodySwap: It comes back {when}. You can switch accounts now, and the task picks up where it stopped.
runError.quota.bodyWait: It comes back {when}. The task is saved and resumes on its own when the quota is back.
runError.budget.title: This month’s budget for {persona} is used up.
runError.budget.body: Raise the limit in Rules, or wait for next month. Nothing was lost.
runError.unreachable.title: I couldn’t reach {provider} right now.
runError.unreachable.body: It looks like an internet or service problem. The task is saved and I’ll try again in a few minutes.
runError.engine.title: {persona}’s engine isn’t available on this computer.
runError.engine.body: Pick another engine so {persona} can keep going.
runError.offline.title: The team is offline.
runError.offline.body: Open Persona on this computer. Tasks resume where they stopped.
